conditions.title: ubuntu-latest moves to Ubuntu 26.04
conditions.fix: Drop or move matrix versions that have no 26.04 build (Python 3.8/3.9, Ruby up to 3.1, old exact patch pins), or pin those jobs to ubuntu-24.04 until you do.

conditions.title: Python 3.15 is the newest Python (3.x, unpinned users and new projects get it)
conditions.fix: Add 3.15 to the test matrix; replace removed sre_* modules with re; lift requires-python caps once tests pass; expect source builds for dependencies with no cp315 wheel.

conditions.title: Node.js 26 becomes LTS (node-version: lts/* moves to 26)
conditions.fix: Pin node-version to 24 if you are not ready, or fix what fails on 26 before lts/* moves.

conditions.title: Alberta, the Northwest Territories, Manitoba and British Columbia stop falling back (tzdata 2026e); the US falls back the same day
conditions.fix: Update bundled time-zone data (tzdata/pytz/moment-timezone/JDK tzdb) to 2026e or later; do not hard-code Canadian UTC offsets in tests. A test that fails only because the clock is past 2026-11-01 has a date limit to move.

conditions.title: GitHub retires the macos-14 runner image
conditions.fix: Move macos-14, macos-14-large and macos-14-xlarge jobs to macos-15 (check Xcode and simulator versions).

conditions.title: JavaScript actions run on Node 24 (Node 20 removed from hosted runners)
conditions.fix: Nothing to run: if your workflows have passed since 23 September, your actions already work on Node 24.
